name: DOCS_RCVD_RESRCSVC_CD_CMP
description: This table stores the codes compiled for a particular service recommended at a community resource.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: GROUP_LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact.

columns.name: VALUE_LINE
columns.description: The line number of one of the multiple values associated with a specific group of data within this contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: DATA_TYPE_C
columns.description: Stores the data types of the compiled codes associated with a community resource service recommended.

columns.name: CODE
columns.description: Stores the compiled codes associated with a community resource service recommended.

columns.name: CODING_SYSTEM
columns.description: Stores the code systems of the compiled codes associated with a community resource service recommended.
